blocks.content: In the earlier lesson, we learned about the if...else statement for making decisions between two alternatives.
While you can use if...else if to handle multiple options, it can become less readable when there are many conditions to check.
In these cases, a switch statement provides a cleaner, more organized approach to handle multiple alternatives.
Let's look at the syntax of a switch statement next.
